corpus_metadata.corpus_name: E. coli Single-Cell ATP Dynamics & Overflow Metabolism Reference Corpus

Pfeiffer2001Cooperation.title: Cooperation and Competition in the Evolution of ATP-Producing Pathways
Pfeiffer2001Cooperation.core_contribution: Formulated the rate-versus-yield trade-off showing why high-rate/low-yield fermentation outcompetes slow/high-yield respiration.

Balaban2004Bacterial.title: Bacterial Persistence as a Phenotypic Switch
Balaban2004Bacterial.core_contribution: Pioneered single-cell microfluidics to discover that persister cells originate from stochastic phenotypic dormancy.

Wolfe2005Acetate.title: The Acetate Switch
Wolfe2005Acetate.core_contribution: Definitive mechanistic review of the reversible transition between Pta-AckA acetate excretion and Acs acetate assimilation.

Eiteman2006Overcoming.title: Overcoming Acetate in Escherichia coli Recombinant Protein Fermentations
Eiteman2006Overcoming.core_contribution: Benchmark analysis of acetate toxicity thresholds and metabolic engineering strategies in industrial recombinant protein production.

Vemuri2006Overflow.title: Overflow Metabolism in Escherichia coli During Steady-State Growth: Transcription-Level Regulation
Vemuri2006Overflow.core_contribution: Identified steady-state transcriptional downregulation of TCA and respiratory chain genes during glucose-excess overflow metabolism.

Imamura2009ATeam.title: Visualization of ATP Levels in Living Cells with Genetically Encoded Fluorescent Indicators
Imamura2009ATeam.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
Imamura2009ATeam.core_contribution: Engineered the first genetically encoded FRET ATP sensor (ATeam) using the bacterial FoF1-ATP synthase epsilon subunit.

Molenaar2009Shifts.title: Shifts in Growth Strategies Reflect Tradeoffs in Cellular Economics
Molenaar2009Shifts.core_contribution: Formulated the foundational coarse-grained self-replicator model showing proteome capacity limits force shifts to overflow pathways.

Wang2010MotherMachine.title: Robust Growth of Escherichia coli
Wang2010MotherMachine.core_contribution: Pioneered the microfluidic Mother Machine, enabling continuous long-term tracking of single bacterial lineages over hundreds of generations.

Scott2010Interdependence.title: Interdependence of Cell Growth and Gene Expression: Origins and Consequences
Scott2010Interdependence.core_contribution: Established phenomenological growth laws linking growth rate to linear proteome allocation partitions between ribosomal and metabolic sectors.

Valgepea2010Systems.title: Systems Biology Approach Reveals That Overflow Metabolism of Acetate in Escherichia coli Is Triggered by Carbon Catabolite Repression of Acetyl-CoA Synthetase
Valgepea2010Systems.core_contribution: Multi-omic chemostat study proving that acetate overflow onset coincides with carbon catabolite repression of acetyl-CoA synthetase (Acs).

Zhuang2011Economics.title: Economics of Membrane Space Prioritize Relative Enzyme Allocations and Predict Metabolic Shifts
Zhuang2011Economics.core_contribution: Formulated the inner membrane surface crowding hypothesis showing that physical space limits on respiratory complexes cause overflow.

Valgepea2013Catalytic.title: Escherichia coli Achieves Faster Growth by Increasing Catalytic and Translation Rates of Proteins
Valgepea2013Catalytic.core_contribution: Showed that cells increase growth rate by tuning operational in vivo enzyme turnover numbers (kcat) alongside proteome reallocation.

Romeo2013Csr.title: The Csr Envelope: Posttranscriptional Regulation in Escherichia coli and Other Bacteria
Romeo2013Csr.core_contribution: Comprehensive review of the CsrA-CsrB-CsrC system regulating glycolytic and acetate flux post-transcriptionally.

Kiviet2014Fluctuations.title: Stochasticity of Metabolism and Growth at the Single-Cell Level
Kiviet2014Fluctuations.core_contribution: Directly demonstrated that metabolic enzyme fluctuations drive transient single-cell growth rate noise and heterogeneity.

Yaginuma2014Diversity.title: Diversity in ATP Concentrations in a Single Bacterial Cell Population Revealed by Quantitative Single-Cell Imaging
Yaginuma2014Diversity.core_contribution: Developed QUEEN ratiometric ATP sensor and quantified non-genetic single-cell ATP bimodal diversity in isogenic E. coli populations.

Basan2015Overflow.title: Overflow Metabolism in Escherichia coli Results from Efficient Proteome Allocation
Basan2015Overflow.core_contribution: Formulated the definitive proteome allocation model: lower proteome investment per ATP in fermentation makes overflow optimal at fast growth.

Hui2015Quantitative.title: Quantitative Proteomic Analysis of Escherichia coli Reveals Principles of Metabolic Allocation
Hui2015Quantitative.core_contribution: Provided absolute proteome sector partitioning (ribosomal, catabolic, anabolic, core) across growth conditions using calibrated mass spectrometry.

Peebo2015Proteome.title: Proteome Reallocation in Escherichia coli with Increasing Specific Growth Rate
Peebo2015Proteome.core_contribution: Quantified proteome reallocation breakpoints into energy and biosynthetic components specifically at the onset of acetate overflow.

Bergmiller2017Biased.title: Biased Cell Division Drives Antibiotic Resistance and Tolerance in Bacteria
Bergmiller2017Biased.core_contribution: Discovered that asymmetric partitioning of multidrug efflux pumps and cellular energy during division generates phenotypic drug-tolerant sublineages.

Kochanowski2017Metabolites.title: Few Regulatory Metabolites Coordinate Expression of Central Metabolic Genes in Escherichia coli
Kochanowski2017Metabolites.core_contribution: Demonstrated that intracellular signaling metabolites (cAMP, FBP) directly drive Crp and Cra to regulate glycolytic and respiratory fluxes.

Shan2017ATP.title: ATP-Dependent Persister Formation in Escherichia coli
Shan2017ATP.core_contribution: Established that stochastic ATP drops directly cause multidrug persister formation through inactivation of antibiotic targets.
